commands.command:
set -eu
git fetch origin work/ux-evolution
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$(git rev-parse origin/work/ux-evolution)"
test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('apps/mobile/src/features/plugs/components/PlugDeleteConfirmModal.test.tsx')
s=p.read_text()
fixes={
 "import { I18nProvider, setLocalePreference }":"import { I18nProvider, setLocalePreference, t }",
 "name: 'Usunąć gniazdko?'":"name: t('hardware.shelly.deleteConfirmTitle')",
 "getIonicButton(dialog, 'Usuń')":"getIonicButton(dialog, t('common.delete'))",
 "name: 'Anuluj'":"name: t('common.cancel')"
}
for old,new in fixes.items():
 assert s.count(old)==1,(old,s.count(old))
 s=s.replace(old,new)
p.write_text(s)
PY
pnpm exec prettier --write apps/mobile/src/features/plugs/components/PlugDeleteConfirmModal.test.tsx
pnpm --filter @lcl/mobile exec vitest run src/features/plugs/components/PlugDeleteConfirmModal.test.tsx src/__tests__/i18n.test.ts src/__tests__/modal.test.tsx --reporter=default
pnpm --filter @lcl/mobile typecheck
git diff --check
git add apps/mobile/src/features/plugs/components/PlugDeleteConfirmModal.test.tsx
git commit -m "test(i18n): assert guarded Plug deletion through translation keys"
git push origin HEAD:refs/heads/work/ux-evolution
echo "TEST_FIX_COMMIT=$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
git status --short
